name: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
title: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd - 532898 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Transmission capex delivered ~₹40,000 cr in FY26 vs ₹28,000 cr initial guide, capitalisation ₹28,206 cr; FY27 capex guide ₹37,000 cr and capitalisation up to ₹30,000 cr, with growth-led execution rather than supply discipline.

capex.peers_comment: Transformer capacity about 300 GVA versus demand 400+ GVA per year; OEMs expanding capacity.
capex.quote: the CapEx which had a guidance of initially about ₹28,000 crores in the initial phase, has been subsequently up to ₹35,000 crore, and eventually we could deliver close to ₹40,000 crore

triggers.label: FY26 capex ~₹40,000 cr vs ₹28,000 cr guide
triggers.quote: eventually we could deliver close to ₹40,000 crore

triggers.label: Capitalisation ₹28,206 cr, FY27 up to ₹30,000 cr

triggers.label: TBCB pipeline ₹1.1 lakh cr under bidding

triggers.label: Equity IRR pressure from cost inflation

next year it should be moving up to ₹35,000 crore
